entry.name: jit.mgraphics
entry.description: The jit.mgraphics object supports drawing 2D vector graphics with the MGraphics API.

messages.digest: Add a path to a graphics context
messages.description: Add a path to a graphics context.

messages.name: arc
messages.digest: Add a circular, clockwise, arc to a path
messages.description: Add a circular, clockwise, arc to the current path.

messages.name: arc_negative
messages.digest: Add a circular, counter-clockwise, arc to a path
messages.description: Add a circular, counter-clockwise, arc to the current path.

messages.name: attr_setfill
messages.digest: Fill a pattern with a named style color

messages.name: clear_surface
messages.digest: Clear the drawing surface
messages.description: Clear the drawing surface and reset to it's initial state.

messages.name: close_path
messages.digest: Close the current path in a context
messages.description: Close the current path in a context.

messages.name: curve_to
messages.digest: Add a cubic Bezier spline to a path
messages.description: Add a cubic Bezier spline to the current path.
messages.argPattern: x1:float, y1:float, x2:float, y2:float, x3:float, y3:float

messages.name: device_to_user
messages.digest: Convert device coordinates to user coordinates
messages.description: Converts device coordinates to user coordinates. User coordinates are those passed to drawing functions. Device coordinates are those of the display device. The result is sent out the dumpout outlet with aprefix.

messages.name: ellipse
messages.digest: Add a closed elliptical path in the context
messages.description: Add a closed elliptical path in the context.

messages.name: fill
messages.digest: Fill the current path and discard it when filled
messages.description: Fill the current path, discarding the path once filled.

messages.name: fill_extents
messages.digest: Report the current path's extents if filled
messages.description: Return the current path's extents if filled. The result is 4 floating point numbers of the form x1, y1, x2, y2, and is sent out the dumpout outlet with aprefix.

messages.name: fill_preserve
messages.digest: Fill the current path and preserve it for further path operations
messages.description: Fill the current path, preserving the path for further path operations.

messages.name: fill_preserve_with_alpha
messages.digest: Fill the current path, applying a global alpha, and preserve it for further path operations
messages.description: Fill the current path, applying a global alpha, and preserving the path for further path operations.

messages.name: fill_with_alpha
messages.digest: Fill the current path, applying a global alpha, and discard it when filled
messages.description: Fill the current path, applying a global alpha, and discarding the path once filled.

messages.name: font_extents
messages.digest: Report the extents of the currently selected font
messages.description: Return the extents of the currently selected font. The result is 3 floating point numbers of the form ascent, descent, height, and is sent out the dumpout outlet with aprefix.

messages.name: get_current_point
messages.digest: Report location of the cursor in a graphics context
messages.description: Get the current location of the cursor in a graphics context. The result is sent out the dumpout outlet with aprefix.

messages.name: get_line_cap
messages.digest: Report the current line cap style
messages.description: Return the current line cap style. The result is a symbol, and is sent out the dumpout outlet with aprefix.

messages.name: get_line_join
messages.digest: Report the current line join style
messages.description: Return the current line join style. The result is a symbol, and is sent out the dumpout outlet with aprefix.

messages.name: get_line_width
messages.digest: Report the current line width
messages.description: Return the current line width. The result is a floating point number, and is sent out the dumpout outlet with aprefix.

messages.name: get_matrix
messages.digest: Report the transform matrix
messages.description: Return the transform matrix. The result is 6 floating point numbers of the form xx, yx, xy, yy, x0, y0, and is sent out the dumpout outlet with aprefix.

messages.name: getfontlist
messages.digest: Report the current font list
messages.description: Return the current font list. The result is a list of symbols, and is sent out the dumpout outlet with aprefix.

messages.name: identity_matrix
messages.digest: Set the current transform to be the identity matrix
messages.description: Set the current transform to be the identity matrix.

messages.name: image_surface_create

messages.description: Create a named image surface, filling with the contents of specified source. Source can be a file name or a matrix name.

messages.description: Destroy a named image surface.

messages.name: image_surface_draw
messages.digest: Draw an image surface
messages.description: Draw an image surface. Supports zoom, but not rotations. Source can be a surface name, file name or a matrix name.

messages.name: image_surface_draw_fast
messages.digest: Draw an image surface quickly
messages.description: Draw an image surface quickly. Does not support zoom or rotations. Source can be a surface name, file name or a matrix name.

messages.name: image_surface_get_size
messages.digest: Report size of an image surface
messages.description: Return the size of an image surface. The result is sent out the dumpout outlet with aprefix.

messages.description: Check if a point is in the current path's fill region. The result is sent out the dumpout outlet with aprefix.

messages.description: Add a line segment to the current path.

messages.description: Move the cursor to a new point and begin a new subpath.

messages.description: Begin a new path.

messages.description: Pops the current group to the current source pattern.

messages.description: Temporarily redirects drawing to an intermediate surface known as a group. Use pop_group, pop_group_to_source, or pop_group_to_surface to use it.

messages.description: Add a closed rectangle path in the context.

messages.description: Move the cursor to a new point and begin a new subpath, using coordinates relative to the current point.

messages.name: restore

messages.description: Restores the saved graphics settings ("pops" the graphics state stack).

messages.name: rotate
messages.digest: Rotate the transform matrix
messages.description: Rotate the transform matrix.

messages.name: save
messages.digest: Save the current graphics settings to be restored later
messages.description: Saves the current graphics settings to be restored later ("pushes" the graphics state stack).

messages.name: scale
messages.digest: Scale the transform matrix
messages.description: Scale the transform matrix.

messages.name: scale_source_rgba
messages.digest: Set the source color transform's scale factor
messages.description: Set the source color transform's scale factor.

messages.description: Specify a font for a graphics context. Themay beor, and Themay beor.

messages.name: set_dash

messages.description: Sets the line drawing style to a dash. The first argument sets the dash length, and the second sets the gap length.

messages.name: set_font_size

messages.description: Specify the font size.

messages.name: set_line_cap

messages.description: Set the current line join style. Values can be: miter, round, or bevel.

messages.description: Set the transform matrix.
messages.argPattern: xx:float, xy:float, yx:float, yy:float, x0:float, y0:float

messages.name: set_source

messages.description: Set the current source to the named pattern or image surface.

messages.description: Set the current source color.

messages.name: show_text

messages.description: Stroke the current path, preserving the path for further path operations.

messages.name: svg_destroy

messages.description: Destroy a named svg object.

messages.description: Add a path of text to the current path.

messages.digest: Converts user coordinates to device coordinates
